_meta.project: IGL Visa Help (formerly Rasel Travel) — Dynamic Visa Intake Form
_meta.structure_correction: v2.0 (visa_100_countries_official_fields.json) wrongly treated student / business / employee as three VISA TYPES. Corrected per Rasel's instruction 2026-11-11: the ONLY visa type is VISIT / TOURIST. Student, businessman and employee are applicant PROFESSIONS (occupation profiles) under the visit visa. Per country: common visit fields + common documents (same for everyone) + per-profession extra fields + extra documents. The v2.0 files are superseded as the build data source.
_meta.field_basis: Harmonised Schengen short-stay form (Reg. (EC) No 810/2009 Annex I); US DS-160 (B-1/B-2); UK Standard Visitor; Canada IMM 5257; Australia Visitor subclass 600 Tourist stream; China COVA L-visa; Singapore Form 14A; national e-Visa / embassy visit forms for the rest. Profession blocks reflect the occupation + financial evidence those official forms and embassy checklists require from students, business owners and salaried employees.
_meta.source_url_policy: Each country carries source_url = its official visa portal entry point and last_verified_at = 2026-11-11 (portal-level stamping, same index as Rasel_Travel_Official_Source_URLs_100_Countries). Field-level re-check on each portal is still advised before live client use.
_meta.excluded_by_design: Visa fees, minimum bank balances, exact photo dimensions/count changes, processing times — excluded because they change by embassy notice.
